I'm a Software Engineer and AI/ML developer from Durgapur, India, currently pursuing Electrical Engineering at University Institute of Technology. My journey bridges hardware fundamentals with cutting-edge AI — building systems that see, understand, and respond intelligently.

From gesture-controlled computers to AI career analyzers, I craft production-ready software that solves real problems. I believe in shipping fast, learning faster, and never stopping at "good enough."

With expertise in Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Generative AI, I specialize in bringing intelligent systems to life — from idea to deployed product.
